body:
you know the exact feeling: taylor steps out in some unreal outfit, and suddenly you're 40 minutes deep reverse-image-searching a single boot. right? ok good, me too.

so we finally built the thing that ends that spiral, and i'm a little obsessed with it.

it's called Seen on Taylor. tap a look she actually wore and it takes you straight to where you can shop the piece — the real one, or the closest match we could track down.

and because we're fans, not a shop pretending to be official: every tile literally says 'her look, not the product.' we point you at what she wore, never claim she's selling it.

go raid your favorite era's closet 🤍 📷 the eras tour, inglewood 2023 — paolo villanueva (cc by 2.0), via wikimedia commons.

why: IG sibling of the shop-the-look announce (see the X item's why for the day-0-vs-how-to decision). Long-form direct-address, different vocabulary/structure from the X post. Sourced from the live merch surface: 'Seen on Taylor' tiles are buy links labeled verbatim 'Her look, not the product'; /?mode=merch verified in deepLink.ts. No item counts asserted. Photo-only is the correct answer here (calendar): no 'Seen on Taylor' screenshot is committed under /social/library/ yet, and the cool-feature rule forbids a flat/empty screenshot — so a credited Taylor Eras-Tour photo (an actual full look, on-theme for shop-the-look) carries the tile. Era fearless per calendar's not-lover/tloas/red rule. Launch arc = share-hook exempt. Lyric-free, blocklist-safe.
